card.name: Linking words in paired descriptive lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as 'and', commas, 'called' or an opening bracket that come right after an adjective or noun and join it to a second item in a pair or list. Most often seen in psychology and treatment descriptions.

modes.label: 'and' joining paired items
modes.description: The word 'and' links two treatment or descriptive terms, such as educational and behavioral.
modes.example: pregnant smokers should be encouraged to attempt cessation using educational<< and>> behavioral interventions before using pharmacological approaches.

modes.label: Naming a second variety
modes.description: A word or bracket introduces the alternative name or second type of a concept, as in informational versus normative influence.
modes.example: These include our need to be right (informational social influence), and our need to be liked<< (>>normative social influence).

modes.label: Comma in an adjective series
modes.description: A comma sits between adjectives in a list.
modes.example: we tend to order our experience in a manner that is regular, orderly, symmetric<<,>> and simple.

card.plain: It fires on small joining words that sit between two paired terms, such as 'and' between two kinds of treatment.
